verdict.rationale: Cactus's own GitHub README documents hybrid routing that sends hard queries to the cloud based on local-model confidence, and a community user reports integrating 'Cactus Hybrid'. So local and cloud inference coexist in the same engine. There is no documentation of which cloud providers are supported, how to configure or connect them, or whether a user can pick a provider directly rather than relying on automatic confidence routing. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported cloud providers, credential and connection setup, manual per-request selection between cloud and local models, and hands-on corroboration of the cloud path.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface

citations.quote: Route hard queries to the cloud automatically based on local model confidence
A user integrated Cactus Hybrid (Gemma 4 with a confidence score) into a mic transcription project
